name: new-assembly
description: Pipeline for creating an entirely new assembly with multiple components
trigger: New assembly design request (e.g., new mounting system, new generator variant)

phases.name: Assembly Planning
phases.description: Define assembly structure, component list, and dependency graph

phases.name: Component Design Loop
phases.description: Run design-pipeline.json for EACH component in dependency order
phases.iteration: For each component defined in P0, respecting dependency order

phases.name: Assembly BOM
phases.description: Aggregate all component BOMs into assembly BOM
